translations.b0220: Part 8  Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization and Steadily Advancing Rural Revitalization in All Respects
translations.b0221: China will continue to prioritize agricultural and rural development and integrated urban-rural development, improve the long-term mechanisms for advancing rural revitalization in all respects, vigorously develop modern agriculture, ensure that rural areas are generally equipped with modern living conditions, continue to consolidate and build on the results of poverty alleviation, narrow the urban-rural development gap, and move faster to build a strong agricultural country.
translations.b0222: Chapter 25  Enhancing Comprehensive Agricultural Production Capacity, Quality and Efficiency
translations.b0223: China will give equal attention to output and production capacity, to production and the environment, and to higher yields and higher incomes; promote the alignment of production with demand, structural optimization and quality improvement; and raise agricultural labor productivity and the contribution of scientific and technological progress.
translations.b0224: Section 1  Strengthening the Supply Guarantee of Grain and Other Important Agricultural Products
translations.b0225: China will further implement the strategy of storing grain in the land and in technology, step up efforts in the new round of action to boost grain production capacity by 100 billion jin, stabilize rice and wheat production, increase the production capacity of corn and soybeans, and work to raise per-unit yields of grain, edible oil and other major crops across large areas. In response to changes in supply and demand, it will optimize the structure of agricultural production, steadily develop the production of important agricultural products such as cotton, edible oil, sugar and natural rubber, and of “shopping basket” products, and develop agriculture with distinctive local features. It will improve the “three-in-one” protection system covering the quantity, quality and ecology of arable land, strictly manage the balance between the occupation and compensation of arable land, improve the quality acceptance mechanism for newly added arable land, and coordinate the optimization of the layout of agricultural land. It will advance high-quality construction and maintenance of high-standard farmland, improve farmland irrigation and drainage systems, strengthen black soil protection and the treatment of acidified farmland, and steadily advance the comprehensive utilization of saline-alkali land. It will strengthen agriculture’s capacity for disaster prevention and mitigation and launch a new round of agricultural resource zoning.
translations.b0226: Section 2  Strengthening Support from Agricultural Science and Technology and Equipment
translations.b0227: China will pursue coordinated development of technology-driven, green, quality-oriented and brand-based agriculture and build agriculture into a modern major industry. It will further implement the action to revitalize the seed industry, strengthen the protection and utilization of germplasm resources, improve the commercial breeding system, intensify collaborative efforts to make breakthroughs in breeding, cultivate new varieties that are high-yielding, high-quality, resistant to stress and widely adaptable, and improve the level of seed source security. It will implement the action for high-quality development of agricultural machinery and equipment, promote the integrated and more efficient application of good farmland, good seed, good machinery and good methods, and raise the comprehensive mechanization rate of plowing, sowing and harvesting to over 80%. It will strengthen efforts to make breakthroughs in core technologies in key fields such as core seed sources, agricultural machinery and equipment, and agricultural water conservation; build a well-tiered agricultural science and technology innovation system based on division of labor and collaboration with appropriate competition; and cultivate leading agricultural science and technology enterprises. It will improve the agricultural technology extension system that combines public welfare services with commercial services, and actively promote geographical indication products and brands.
translations.b0228: Section 3  Building a Diversified Food Supply System
translations.b0229: China will develop farming, forestry, animal husbandry and fisheries in parallel and tap food resources through all channels and by multiple means. It will strengthen comprehensive regulation of hog production capacity, improve the quality and efficiency of the beef cattle, mutton sheep and dairy cattle industries, and accelerate the transformation and upgrading of grassland animal husbandry. It will accelerate the development of the forage industry and expand the production of silage. It will develop modern facility agriculture, promote energy-conserving, machinery-friendly and highly efficient facility-based cultivation, and advance intensive livestock and poultry farming. It will scientifically develop food resources from rivers, lakes, seas and forests, develop high-quality aquaculture, steadily expand the production of woody grain and oil crops, develop the under-forest economy, expand the forest and grass industries, and raise the level of mechanization. It will actively develop synthetic biology technologies and expand new sources of protein.
translations.b0230: Chapter 26  Building Beautiful and Harmonious Villages That Are Good Places to Live and Work
translations.b0231: China will study and apply the experience of the “Ten Million Project,” advance rural revitalization in a categorized, orderly and area-based manner, further implement the rural construction action, and gradually make rural infrastructure more complete, public services more convenient and the living environment more comfortable.
translations.b0232: Section 1  Creating High-Quality Living Space in Rural Areas
translations.b0233: China will scientifically plan the layout of infrastructure and public services with the county as the unit and promote the integrated planning, construction and maintenance of infrastructure within counties. It will coordinate and optimize the layout of villages and towns, guide the appropriate concentration of population and industries, improve the implementation mechanisms for rural construction in light of local conditions, and rationally arrange construction priorities and sequencing. It will advance coordinated territorial space governance at the county level, steadily carry out comprehensive land consolidation across entire areas, and provide land for rural development according to category. It will make solid progress in building and maintaining rural facilities for roads, water supply, sewage treatment, energy, logistics and information, and continue to renovate dilapidated rural houses. It will improve the operating conditions of regular senior secondary schools and boarding schools in counties, advance the building of tight-knit county-level medical communities with a focus on channeling medical personnel to the grassroots, improve the three-tier elderly care service network at the county, township and village levels, support the provision of flexible forms of basic public services to rural areas in remote regions, and make coordinated use of existing rural facility resources. It will continue to improve the rural living environment and, with perseverance, solve problems such as rural toilet renovation and garbage encroaching on villages.
translations.b0234: Section 2  Developing County-Level Industries That Enrich the People
translations.b0235: China will develop county economies with distinctive features, promote the deep integration of primary, secondary and tertiary industries in rural areas, cultivate agricultural powerhouse counties, major industrial counties and renowned tourism counties in light of local conditions, and promote the integrated development of industry, county strength and people’s prosperity. It will promote the transformation and upgrading of agricultural product processing, strengthen the development of agricultural product markets and distribution networks, and improve storage, preservation and cold-chain logistics systems. It will unlock the multiple functions of agriculture and cultivate and strengthen rural industries with distinctive features and new industries and business forms such as rural leisure tourism, cultural experiences and rural e-commerce. It will develop farmers’ cooperatives in a well-regulated manner, cultivate leading enterprises in agricultural industrialization, improve the mechanisms for linking enterprises with farmers, link support policies for new types of agricultural business entities to increases in farmers’ incomes, and promote steady growth in farmers’ incomes.
translations.b0236: Section 3  Strengthening and Improving Rural Governance
translations.b0237: China will further promote rural revitalization in all respects through Party building, improve the three-tier governance system at the county, township and village levels, select the best and strongest members for village Party branch committees and villagers’ committees, especially their leaders, and improve the mechanisms for selecting, dispatching and managing first Party secretaries and work teams stationed in villages. It will promote the standardized development of villagers’ self-governance organizations, improve the systems for making village affairs public and for democratic deliberation, and support farmers in participating in village-level deliberation and consultation through multiple channels. It will strengthen the development of spiritual civilization in rural areas in the new era, promote the flourishing of rural culture, and implement the project for fostering civilized rural customs. It will continue to address the problem of excessive bride prices in rural areas. It will protect and pass on rural cultural heritage, strengthen the protection of vernacular architecture and traditional villages, and carry forward the agricultural civilization.
translations.b0238: Chapter 27  Improving the Effectiveness of Policies for Strengthening Agriculture, Benefiting Farmers and Enriching Rural Residents
translations.b0239: China will improve the institutional mechanisms and policy system for prioritizing agricultural and rural development, promote the two-way flow of production factors between urban and rural areas, and enhance the vitality of agricultural and rural development.
translations.b0240: Section 1  Strengthening Investment Guarantees for Agriculture and Rural Areas
translations.b0241: China will improve a diversified investment pattern in which fiscal spending gives priority, finance provides focused support, and society actively participates, ensuring that investment in rural revitalization continues to increase. It will give priority to ensuring general public budget investment in agriculture and rural areas and improve the effectiveness of fiscal policies supporting agriculture and the efficiency of fiscal funds. It will improve the mechanism for ensuring the incomes of grain farmers, strengthen and coordinate policy support in the form of prices, subsidies and insurance, and protect and stimulate farmers’ enthusiasm for farming and growing grain. It will increase compensation to major grain-producing areas, implement inter-provincial horizontal benefit compensation between production and marketing areas, and improve the reward and subsidy system for major grain-producing counties. It will improve the financial service system suited to the characteristics of agriculture and rural areas, develop multi-tiered agricultural insurance, and support the development of insurance for agricultural products with distinctive features.
translations.b0242: Section 2  Deepening Agricultural and Rural Reform
translations.b0243: China will consolidate and improve the basic rural operating system, stabilize land contracting relations, steadily advance pilot programs for extending the second round of land contracts by another 30 years upon expiration, and improve the pricing mechanism and the management and service systems for the transfer of contracted land management rights. It will develop appropriately scaled agricultural operations, improve the development quality of new types of agricultural business entities, improve the convenient and efficient agricultural social service system, and promote the organic integration of small farmers into modern agricultural development. It will deepen comprehensive reform of supply and marketing cooperatives. It will use rural collective commercial construction land economically and intensively, orderly advance reform to allow such land to enter the market, and improve the mechanism for distributing land value-added returns. It will move faster to complete the confirmation, registration and certification of rural homestead rights together with the corresponding housing, strengthen the standardized management of rural homesteads, and lawfully revitalize and make good use of idle land and houses. It will deepen reform of the rural collective property rights system and support the development of a new type of rural collective economy. It will strengthen the standardized development of rural property rights trading markets, and encourage all types of talent to provide services, start businesses and seek employment in rural areas.
translations.b0244: Section 3  Improving the Regular Assistance Mechanism
translations.b0245: China will establish, in a coordinated way, a regular mechanism for preventing a return to poverty and new poverty, persist in targeted assistance, improve basic safety-net guarantees, strengthen development-oriented assistance through industry, employment and other means, enhance self-sustaining momentum, provide assistance to underdeveloped areas by category and tier, and ensure that no large-scale return to poverty or new poverty occurs. It will optimize the scope of the existing key counties for national rural revitalization assistance and improve support policies and incentive and restraint mechanisms. It will optimize and improve mechanisms such as East-West cooperation and paired cooperation, continue the designated assistance provided by central government departments and institutions, and further carry out “group-based” assistance by officials and professionals. It will focus on large and extra-large resettlement areas and strengthen follow-up support for people relocated from inhospitable areas. It will advance market-oriented consumption assistance, strengthen the standardized management of the assets of assistance projects, and step up efforts to expand the scope of work-relief programs. It will advance disaster-avoidance relocation in a coordinated manner.
